items.question: According to the UAE Skills platform, approximately how many talents does the national platform aim to support in developing their skills?
items.fact: UAE Skills platform aims to support over 1,700 talents

items.question: Can you create an account on the UAE Skills platform by registering with just an email address?
items.gold: Yes, you can register using your email address.
items.fact: UAE Skills accounts can be created using an email address
